english.note: Use this when the renown emphasizes an established person’s prestige or standing rather than celebrity alone.

exampleSentences.english: That veteran Chinese doctor has considerable renown in the local community.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰位老中醫喺本區行醫幾十年，名望好高。
